description: Pixel art TV home shopping broadcast frame, a 2000s CRT TV shot, 4:3, inside the same late-night home shopping studio as in the reference picture: red and black lacquer with gold trim. The picture fills the entire canvas edge to edge. The camera stands on the stage and looks at the studio audience bleachers with real depth: seven long rows of identical red velvet theater seats with gold trim rising in steps toward the back, the front row big and close, each row behind smaller, the rows running past both edges of the frame; every seat is empty. The bleachers fill the frame up to the top edge. On the back wall at the top left, above the last row: a small double audience door with a small unlit blank lightbox sign beside it. On the back wall at the top middle: a small unlit blank lightbox sign. Below the bleachers, the lower third of the frame: a strip of yellow and black floor tape across the floor, then the glossy dark stage floor with a taped X mark on the right. LIGHT: bright studio light on the stage floor, the bleachers a little dimmer. Dense, highly detailed pixel art, crisp pixel clusters, no dithering, no blur. No people, no letters, no words, no numbers.

reference_images.usage_description: STYLE AND SET: the same studio, red and black lacquer with gold trim, the same pixel art style, colors and lighting. Do not copy the layout or the host.

LAYOUT AND DEPTH from this line drawing: seven stepped rows filling the frame to the top of identical seats, big in front and smaller toward the back, running past both edges; the door and sign at the top left; the back wall sign at the top middle; the floor tape strip and the wide stage floor in the lower third with the X mark. Do not copy the white or the lines.
